summary: Iteration 103: Verified all 6 new features/bug fixes for MoneySutra. Backend: 12/12 tests passed for wealth-impact and regret endpoints. Frontend: All features working - ProfileMenu dropdown visible on Wealth page, notification redirect to /health working, Wealth Impact Analysis with 50/30/20 grading, Regret Check with Happy/Sad buttons, Sutra Swap opportunity cost suggestions.
critical_code_review_comments: Wealth.js Line 104: overflow-hidden removed from header - ProfileMenu dropdown now visible
NotificationBell.js Line 141-148: Type-based fallback routing correctly maps gamification/achievement/streak to /health
expenses.py Line 1208-1221: PATCH /{expense_id}/regret endpoint working - sets/clears regret flag
expenses.py Line 1259-1401: GET /wealth-impact returns complete data structure with wealthGrade, allocation, lifestyleOver5k, regretExpenses, opportunitySwaps
WealthImpactAnalysis.js: Expandable bottom-sheet with GradeRing, AllocationBar, Regret Check, Sutra Swap sections all functional
ExpenseMonthly.js Line 357-360: WealthImpactAnalysis component properly rendered at bottom of Monthly tab
seed_data_creation: Used existing test user data - Petrol expense (Travel category, ₹6,000) used for Regret Check testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 6 features verified: 1) Wealth page ProfileMenu dropdown now visible - no overflow clipping. 2) Notification click redirects to /health for gamification/achievement/streak types. 3) GET /api/expenses/wealth-impact returns wealthGrade (A+ to F based on 50/30/20 rule), allocation breakdown, lifestyleOver5k array, regretExpenses, opportunitySwaps. 4) PATCH /api/expenses/{id}/regret sets/clears regret flag - tested with Petrol expense. 5) Monthly tab (/my-expenses?tab=monthly) shows Wealth Impact Analysis expandable section at bottom with Grade ring (C+), allocation bars, Regret Check for Wants > ₹5K. 6) Sutra Swap appears after marking expense as regret showing opportunity costs (goal %, investment growth). No UI overlap issues in MyExpenses list view - 36px gap maintained between month summary and expense breakdown.
